plugins.Author: Rey Alex
plugins.Name: Gpose Cast
plugins.Description: A compact GPose casting tool. Search visible actors, import overworld players into GPose for Brio/Ktisis, build a picked group, and hide everyone else locally for cleaner screenshots.
plugins.Punchline: Build a picked GPose cast and hide everyone else.
plugins.Changelog: 0.9.0.7: fixes the GPose actor import range so imports can continue beyond the previous 38-actor ceiling, using GPose slots 201-439.
plugins.TestingChangelog: 0.9.1.0 testing: adds the searchable pose library, private 3D pose preview and pose apply, synced preview appearance support, Hi-Res GPose presets, and redesigned settings.
